setup: Enumerate and look up obligations through advanced diagnostics from application and advanced hosts.
assertion: Only IDurableResourceLeaseDiagnostics exposes detached correlated obligation/ticket facts; ordinary handles and built-in remote endpoints expose none.

setup: Expose diagnostics through an optional host adapter.
assertion: Authorization and redaction are adapter-owned and outside Phase 0; no caller seam is added.

setup: Cross one bound/unbound confirmation ID with live, confirmed, unknown, and normally released tokens.
assertion: Precedence is ConfirmationConflict, AlreadyConfirmed, NotConfirmable, Released, TokenNotFound with no fallthrough ambiguity.

setup: Serialize normal release against a truthful stop confirmation.
assertion: The committed winner determines Released or TokenNotFound and capacity changes exactly once.

setup: Replay confirmations and token lookup after accepted confirmation, normal release, and retention purge.
assertion: Confirmation bindings and token tombstones preserve idempotence during retention; purge can only yield TokenNotFound.

setup: Submit stale, mismatched, false, or token-swapped stop proof.
assertion: No capacity is released and the proof cannot bind a confirmation ID.

setup: Reconcile an obligation whose tickets span pools with different provider evidence.
assertion: Review marks are per ticket and copied facts retain pool, units, ticket, generation, and obligation correlation.

setup: Crash after provider release but before governance release commit.
assertion: Causal provider evidence closes the release gap idempotently without a second release.

setup: Reconcile a supposedly held obligation when the provider lacks one ticket.
assertion: The workflow records LeaseLost and follows definite failure/quarantine rules rather than recreating ownership.

setup: Compare certified stop proof with elapsed time, renewal failure, or host disappearance.
assertion: Only certified truthful confirmation releases ambiguous capacity; time and renewal never reclaim it.
